revisions.title: Rising symbol
revisions.summary: The six-dot symbol flipped top to bottom: its rows now hold one, two and three dots, so the mark climbs to the right instead of stepping down.
rationale: Read left to right, the dots rise. For a name that ends in north, the mark points the way the name does; the approved 3-2-1 arrangement steps down and to the right.
The heaviest row now sits on the baseline with the lettering, and the single dot rises to the height of the first d’s ascender, so the symbol leads into the wordmark instead of hanging beside it.

Nothing else changes: the same six circles, radius, equal spacing, wordmark, colours and lockup proportions. Every logo, template, pattern and icon follows from the one change to the symbol’s centres.
The approved files stay as they are until this is accepted. The v2.1 guide records the 3-2-1 orientation as deliberate, so this is a proposal to decide on, not a correction.
